properties.displayName: [Custom] Kubernetes cluster containers should not share the host PID or IPC namespace
properties.description: Custom OPA/Rego-backed Azure Policy definition. Wraps the open-source Gatekeeper library's K8sPSPHostNamespace constraint template (https://github.com/open-policy-agent/gatekeeper-library/tree/master/library/pod-security-policy/host-namespaces) to block pods that set hostPID or hostIPC to true.

metadata.description: 'audit' allows a non-compliant resource to be created but flags it as non-compliant. 'deny' blocks the non-compliant resource from being created. 'disabled' turns off the policy.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to include in policy evaluation. An empty list means all namespaces not explicitly excluded.
List of Kubernetes namespaces to exclude from policy evaluation.
